name: Milena Jovanović
bio: Milena's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally training as a mechanical engineer, she found herself drawn to the intricate dance between aerodynamics and velocity while working on a university project. This fascination led her to pursue a specialized course in wind tunnel technology, ultimately landing her a role assisting senior operators. She approaches her work with meticulous attention to detail, believing that even the smallest anomaly in data can reveal crucial insights. While relatively new to the professional scene, Milena is eager to learn and contribute her unique perspective to a winning team, always seeking to understand the bigger picture of how her work impacts overall performance.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Milena is of average height with a thoughtful expression and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn diagrams and calculations.
Insists on brewing her own strong Serbian coffee before each wind tunnel session.
Has a habit of muttering equations under her breath when analyzing data.
